_comment: v3 queue (2026-09-14). Ad-creative positioning. Every topic carries the evidence that justifies it. Strengthen jobs keep the URL. Evidence = Search Console, 3 months to 2026-09-11, unless stated.

evidence.source: GSC query | GSC page | AI baseline | Abhi

_schema.angle: what the page must answer better than today
_schema.links_in_from: existing pages that should link to it

topics.reader: Growth lead at a DTC brand whose Meta results slip when creative runs stale

evidence.string: scale ad creative without breaking brand systems

topics.angle: How brands produce more ads per month without breaking the brand: volume targets tied to spend, the production options and their real costs, and where AI statics and video fit. Remove unsourced stats.

topics.reader: DTC founder or CMO hiring a creative partner
topics.angle: Rewrite from 'CPG agency for everything' to an accurate page: what kinds of DTC agencies exist (branding, performance, creative production), what each costs (link /ad-creative-agency-pricing), and where 100 Creatives fits as the ad-creative production partner. Verdict rule applies.

topics.reader: Ecommerce marketer who needs ad creative for Shopify products
topics.angle: What ecommerce ad creative production involves (formats, product imagery, volume), options and costs, 100 Creatives' scoped fit.

topics.reader: Marketing lead at a supplement or wellness brand

evidence.impressions: 102 at avg position 18.4; 10 Google AI-feature impressions

evidence.string: health and wellness cpg branding agency

topics.angle: Ad creative for health and wellness brands: Meta's health and wellness ad policies and claim limits (cite Meta's policy pages), what compliant statics and video look like, and 100 Creatives' scoped fit. No named clients.

evidence.string: what are different styles of ugc ads i can create

topics.angle: UGC-style static and video ads: the styles, when they beat polished creative, disclosure rules for creator-style ads (cite FTC/Meta), how to make them without creators, and costs.

topics.reader: DTC marketer sizing monthly creative volume

evidence.string: how do brands with 2,000+ sku catalogs manage producing meta ad creatives for each product without a dedicated design team?
how many ad creatives to test

topics.angle: A sourced way to size creative volume by spend and account structure (cite Meta's own creative guidance where possible), including the large-catalog case and catalog/dynamic ads.

topics.reader: Media buyer or creative strategist building a testing process

evidence.string: best practices for scaling ad creation on social media
what's the best way to test ad creatives at scale

topics.angle: A testing framework grounded in Meta's documented testing tools (A/B test, Advantage+ creative) with sourced guidance; remove the unsourced '20-40% CAC reduction' claim.

topics.reader: DTC brand choosing between a performance agency and a creative production partner
topics.angle: What a performance creative agency does vs a media-buying agency vs a production partner, prices (link /ad-creative-agency-pricing), and 100 Creatives' scoped fit (creative only).

topics.reader: DTC marketer who wants video ads for Reels and TikTok without a shoot

evidence.string: static and video creative agency but using AI

topics.angle: Service and guide page for AI-made video ads: what AI video tools do well and badly for product ads today (sourced, hedged), formats and specs for Reels/TikTok/Stories (cite platform docs), how 100 Creatives makes them, prices from FACTS.md, and when a real shoot or UGC creators are the better buy.
